# Abstraction charges

Brackenmere Water, schedule for 2026.

Licence LR-22/451 is charged at 0.42 per cubic metre abstracted. The charge
is raised monthly on the volumes the licence holder reports for that month,
and a month with no abstraction carries no charge.

Licence LR-22/302, held in the Cranmoor catchment, is charged at 0.35 per
cubic metre under its own schedule.

# Cranmoor catchment licence notes

Brackenmere Water.

Abstraction in the Cranmoor catchment is charged at 0.35 per cubic metre and
is reported on its own return. Licences elsewhere in the region are charged
under the regional schedule.

# Hollinsgate Irrigation - abstraction log

One row for each day the pump ran in September, with the volume taken that
day. The licence number is written on every row and the charge is raised
monthly on the volumes reported.
